Fixture JSON is generated from independent literal sources in
`fixtures_generate_test.go` and `workflow_generate_test.go`. Run their artifact
tests with `-update-golden` to generate missing files; normal runs reject missing
or changed files. V1 artifacts and default-export hashes remain frozen.

The v3 `adapter-v3/inputs.json` vectors are hand-authored independent literals.
Tests compare matching-definition observations with the cron resolver; stale
observations intentionally differ. The request-values trigger exercises the
0.49.0 API floor, not request value precedence (covered by the resolver); the expected
delivery outcomes are not generated by the adapter bridge. V1 and v2 exports
remain unchanged.
